name: Swarm Reverb
description: A cavern built from a swarm of short echoes instead of a smooth tail, with a Stretch control that resizes the whole cave and bends everything in it in pitch.

params.name: Length
params.description: How long the swarm of echoes after each note lasts. Short is a tight cluster behind the note, long a slow scatter across a huge cave. Moving it bends what is ringing.

params.name: Blur
params.description: Smears the echoes into each other. At zero each one patters separately; turned up they run together into a wash.

params.name: Feedback
params.description: How much of the swarm is sent round again. Low is one rush of echoes, high a cave that rings for a long time. At the very top it never dies and feeds on itself.

params.name: High Cut
params.description: How bright the cave is. Lower settings take the top off the echoes, and more of it each time they go round.

params.name: Stretch
params.description: Stretches or shrinks every echo at once. While it moves, everything in the cave bends in pitch: down as it grows, up as it shrinks. The middle is the size Length sets.

params.name: Glide
params.description: How quickly the cave follows Stretch. Fast gives a sharp jump in pitch, slow a long slide.

params.name: Steps
params.description: With Steps on, Stretch moves between seven sizes related by octaves, fifths and fourths, so every move is heard as a musical interval instead of a free bend.

params.name: Wander
params.description: Lets Stretch drift on its own so the cave keeps shifting. Smooth and seasick with Steps off; occasional interval jumps with Steps on.

params.name: Modulation
params.description: Slow movement of single echoes, each at its own rate. A little keeps the swarm from sounding fixed and metallic; a lot makes it shimmer, and held notes swell and fade.

params.name: Low Cut
params.description: Removes bass from the echoes, and more of it each time they go round, so the cave does not turn to mud.

params.name: Width
params.description: Stereo width of the echoes only. Zero is a mono cave; full spreads the swarm across both sides.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry sound and the cave.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit; no published design is followed. A multi-tap cluster reverb on a delay line whose clock speed can be changed. Two cross-coupled delay lines are each read by fourteen uneven, seeded taps, with allpass diffusion in front and a filtered regeneration loop; every delay is a distance on one tape whose speed Length and Stretch set, and the read points are found from the history of the tape position, so a speed change bends everything on the line by one ratio, as a variable-clock delay does.
